title: architectureRules
responsibility: Checks directional import boundaries and requires named types to be separate from runtime implementations.

inputs.name: auditArchitecture.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path whose directional imports are checked.

inputs.name: auditArchitecture.lines
inputs.description: Structural source lines used to inspect import boundaries.

inputs.name: auditTypePlacement.file
inputs.description: Source contents, extension and repository path; Svelte script blocks are inspected together.

outputs.name: auditArchitecture
outputs.description: Import-boundary violations for core, templates and thin command modules.

outputs.name: auditTypePlacement
outputs.description: Findings for named interfaces or type aliases mixed with executable declarations; separate type modules and declaration files are accepted.
